title: Ballet — Automate your team's best ideas across your revenue stack
excerpt: Growth ideas stall when they need systems connected and engineering roadmaps aren't fast enough. Ballet is the fix: describe the outcome and it builds it, runs it, keeps it working.
content_html:
Your most ambitious automations shouldn’t stay in your backlog

Get started

Built by the team behind Brainfish, trusted by:

How it works

Skip the engineering queue. Ballet automates your team’s best ideas across your revenue stack.

Growth ideas stall when they need systems connected, and engineering roadmaps aren’t fast enough. Ballet is the fix. Describe the outcome — lead routing, attribution, a renewal play — and Ballet builds it, runs it, keeps it working.

Ballet is a workflow-automation platform from the team behind Brainfish. Describe a multi-system outcome in plain English and Ballet builds it as reviewable, version-controlled code — deterministic where accuracy matters, agentic where judgment helps.

Connector libraries cap out when your stack is proprietary or the graph gets huge. Ballet writes the integration against any API the moment you need it, and the workflow runs as inspectable code instead of a brittle visual graph.

Yes where it matters. Ballet writes deterministic workflow code your engineers can read, approve, and replay. Agentic reasoning is used only on steps that benefit from flexibility — not on the steps that must never drift.

Design partners with real multi-system workflows stuck behind an engineering queue — RevOps, Support Ops, and product-led growth teams. You bring one backlog workflow; we model it on your systems in a short working session.

Generated code is visible and version-controlled, with approval gates and replayable runs. Ballet is part of Brainfish and covered by Brainfish’s SOC2 Type II compliance. Details live in the Trust Center at https://trust.brainfi.sh/.

Brainfish is the knowledge layer; Ballet is the execution layer. Customers can trigger Ballet workflows from Brainfish, and Ballet also runs standalone against your existing stack.

Let’s go

Bring the workflow that’s been in your backlog for two quarters.

We’ll model it in Ballet on your real systems in a 30-minute working session. No SOW, no scope creep. One of our specialists runs it with you.

Get started

FAQ

有问题，有答案。

Ballet 是 Brainfish 背后团队开发的工作流程自动化平台。 用简单的英语描述多系统结果，Ballet 将其构建为可审查的、版本控制的代码——在准确性重要的地方是确定性的，在判断有帮助的地方是代理性的。

当您的堆栈是专有的或图表变得巨大时，连接器库就会达到上限。 Ballet 在您需要时针对任何 API 编写集成，并且工作流程作为可检查代码而不是脆弱的可视化图形运行。

是的，重要的是。 Ballet 编写确定性工作流程代码，您的工程师可以阅读、批准和重播。 代理推理仅用于受益于灵活性的步骤，而不用于绝对不能漂移的步骤。

具有真正的多系统工作流程的设计合作伙伴陷入了工程队列的后面——RevOps、支持运营和产品主导的增长团队。 您带来一个待办事项工作流程；我们会在短时间内在您的系统上对其进行建模。

生成的代码是可见的并且受版本控制，具有批准门和可重播的运行。 Ballet 是 Brainfish 的一部分，并符合 Brainfish 的 SOC2 Type II 合规性。 详细信息位于信任中心 https://trust.brainfi.sh/。

Brainfish是知识层； Ballet是执行层。 客户可以从 Brainfish 触发 Ballet 工作流程，并且 Ballet 还可以针对您现有的堆栈独立运行。
